title: 🎓 Student Internship / Pflichtpraktikum (m/w/d)
description:
📌 JOIN THE EXZELLENT SQUAD

🎓 Student Internship / Pflichtpraktikum (m/w/d)

🇩🇪 Exzellent | Registered in Germany

📌 ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for motivated university students who are searching for a compulsory internship and want to gain practical experience while working with a growing company.

At Exzellent, interns can get involved in different areas of the business depending on their skills and interests. You may work on real projects, take responsibility for tasks and contribute ideas to the team.

We’re looking for people who are willing to learn, take initiative and are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.

📌 WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

▪️ Currently studying at a university or higher-education institution

▪️ Looking for a compulsory/mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum)

▪️ Reliable, motivated and responsible

▪️ Good communication and interpersonal skills

▪️ Interested in marketing, social media or business development

▪️ Comfortable working independently and within a team

▪️ Good organizational and problem-solving skills

▪️ Willing to learn new tools and take on different responsibilities

▪️ Interested in entrepreneurship, teamwork and leadership

Knowledge of an additional language is a plus. German, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese and other languages can be useful depending on the role and the markets we work with.

📌 WHAT YOU MAY WORK ON

Your responsibilities will depend on your skills, interests and the needs of the company.

You may work in areas such as:

▪️ Website and digital operations

▪️ Marketing and social media

▪️ Business development and growth

▪️ AI tools and automation

▪️ Recruitment and team coordination

▪️ Tutor and webinar coordination

▪️ Documentation and SOPs

▪️ Product research and development

▪️ Strategy and day-to-day operations

You don’t need to have experience in all of these areas. What matters more is your willingness to learn and your ability to adapt.

📌 DO YOU HAVE A SKILL YOU CAN TEACH?

If you have strong knowledge of a language, academic subject, professional skill or practical field, you may also have the opportunity to support or teach courses through the Exzellent platform.

We value people who are willing to learn from others and share their own knowledge.

📌 REPRESENT EXZELLENT

As you become more familiar with the company, you may also have the opportunity to represent Exzellent within your university, student community or professional network.

Selected interns may receive referral opportunities and gain practical experience in networking, marketing, outreach and community building.

📌 FREELANCE OPPORTUNITIES

Depending on your skills, availability and performance, there may also be opportunities to work on separate freelance projects alongside your studies.

These projects may include tutoring, content, marketing, outreach, digital work and other project-based assignments.

📌 WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

We believe good leadership starts with taking responsibility.

We value people who:

▪️ Take ownership of their work

▪️ Look for solutions when problems come up

▪️ Communicate clearly with the team

▪️ Support their colleagues

▪️ Take initiative when something needs to be done

▪️ Are open to feedback and willing to improve

▪️ Think beyond their own assigned tasks

If you notice something that could be improved, we want you to feel comfortable sharing your ideas and suggesting practical solutions.

📌 WHAT TO EXPECT

The first month will focus on getting familiar with Exzellent, understanding how the team works and completing initial assignments.

After the probation period, additional opportunities may be available depending on your skills, contribution and performance.

These may include:

▪️ Stipend opportunities

▪️ Performance-based bonuses

▪️ Referral opportunities

▪️ Tutoring or course opportunities

▪️ Freelance projects

▪️ Ambassador responsibilities

▪️ Additional team responsibilities

▪️ Longer-term opportunities within Exzellent

📌 GROW WITH US

The goal of this internship is not simply to complete the required internship hours.

We’re interested in people who may want to continue working with us after their internship and take on greater responsibilities over time.

Interns who consistently demonstrate reliability, ownership, good teamwork and meaningful contribution may be given additional responsibilities as the company grows.

For the right candidates, this may eventually lead to opportunities within the core team.

These opportunities are performance-based and are not guaranteed.

📌 READY TO GET STARTED?

If you’re looking for an internship where you can gain practical experience, work with a real team and contribute to different areas of a growing company, we’d be happy to hear from you.

📩 Apply to join the Exzellent Squad (m/w/d). At jobs@exzellent.co

title: Care Manager
description:
**Company Description**
EverNest Care is an elder-care organization focused on providing coordinated, everyday support for senior citizens and peace of mind for their families. The company bridges geographical distance through services such as personal assistance, home care, health monitoring, appointment coordination, medication reminders, companionship, and emergency support. Its care model emphasizes proactive support, regular communication, and personalized care plans tailored to individual routines and preferences. EverNest Care combines technology, trained professionals, and compassionate human support to build a trusted elder-care ecosystem. The organization is committed to making later years safer, healthier, more dignified, and emotionally fulfilling for older adults.

**Role Description**
The Care Manager role at EVERNEST CARE LLP is a full-time, on-site position based in Alappuzha. The Care Manager coordinates and oversees individualized elder-care plans, ensuring that each client’s medical, social, and daily living needs are consistently met. Day-to-day responsibilities include assessing client requirements, organizing home care services, monitoring health and wellness, scheduling and tracking medical appointments, and facilitating medication reminders. The role involves regular communication with families, documenting care activities, responding to emerging needs, and collaborating with healthcare professionals and community resources. The Care Manager also supports companionship initiatives, promotes safety and dignity at home, and contributes to continuous improvement of care processes and training within the team.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in case management, including assessment, care planning, coordination, and follow-up.
* Background in elder care, with an understanding of ageing-related needs, safety, and dignity in home-based support.
* Exposure to social services or community-based programs that connect older adults with relevant resources and support networks.
* Foundational knowledge of medicine or health care sufficient to understand medical instructions, monitor basic health indicators, and communicate effectively with clinicians.
* Ability to conduct training or guidance for caregivers and staff on care protocols, communication, and client safety.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to build trust with older adults and their families.
* Good organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail in scheduling, record-keeping, and follow-up.
* Relevant degree or certification in social work, nursing, gerontology, psychology, or a related field is preferred.
* Previous experience in elder-care settings, home care coordination, or case management is an advantage.

The organization focuses on guiding learners through every stage of the study\-abroad journey, from counseling and application support to admission and pre\-departure processes. UES ABROAD values long\-term relationships with students and families, aiming to be a trusted partner throughout their academic and professional development. The company builds its reputation on honesty, sincerity, and personalized support, offering clear and accurate information to help students make confident decisions. Team members are encouraged to contribute to a service\-oriented culture that prioritizes integrity and student success.

 The Video Presenter Cum Content Creator is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Palakkad. In this position, the team member will present and host educational and promotional videos that explain study\-abroad options, application processes, and institutional highlights in a clear and engaging manner. The role involves planning video concepts, writing scripts or outlines, and collaborating with counselors and other staff to ensure content is accurate and aligned with UES ABROAD’s services. Day\-to\-day tasks include recording videos, coordinating with videographers or production staff, reviewing and refining content before publishing, and adapting material for different platforms such as social media and the company website. The team member will also help generate ideas for new content, track audience engagement, and adjust messaging to better reach prospective students and their families.
